title: GR143683
text:
PRIORITY DESIGNS WILL PROVIDE MEDICAL DEVICE QUALITY AND REGULATORY EXPERTISE IN SUPPORT OF
THE FOLLOWING SPECIFIC AIMS, MAJOR TASKS, AND SUBTASKS FOR THIS PROJECT:
 SPECIFIC AIM 1 - MAJOR TASK 3 - PRODUCT VERIFICATION AND VALIDATION (V&V)
O SUBTASK 3.1 - PREPARE FINAL SYSTEM FOR V&V
 SPECIFIC AIM 3 - MAJOR TASK 7 - 510(K) PREPARATION
O SUBTASK 7.1 - PREPARE DESIGN HISTORY FILE
O SUBTASK 7.2 - PREPARE AND SUBMIT PRE-SUBMISSIONS TO FDA
SPECIFIC ACTIVITIES THAT PRIORITY DESIGNS WILL SUPPORT INCLUDE:
 REVIEW QUALITY MANAGEMENT SYSTEM (QMS) SOPS AND DESIGN HISTORY FILES (DHF)
FROM PRIORITY DESIGNS, OSU, CONTRACT MANUFACTURERS, AND SUPPLIERS TO HELP PLAN FOR
QMS INTEGRATION.
 HELP DEVELOP SYSTEM DOCUMENTATION AND PLAN REQUIRED TESTING.
 PROVIDE REGULATORY AND QUALITY EXPERTISE IN MEETINGS (GENERALLY WEEKLY) BETWEEN
PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT, QUALITY, SYSTEMS ENGINEERING, ELECTRICAL ENGINEERING,
MECHANICAL ENGINEERING, SOFTWARE ENGINEERING, REGULATORY, MANUFACTURING, AND
SUPPLIER TEAMS.
 SUPPORT DEVELOPMENT OF FDA PRE-SUBMISSIONS FOR DATA DEVELOPMENT PLAN AND
HUMAN FACTORS SUMMATIVE PLAN.
 SUBMIT PRE-SUBMISSIONS TO FDA THROUGH PROPER CHANNELS AND SUPPORT RESPONSE TO
FDA FEEDBACK.
 LEAD DESIGN INPUTS REVIEW AND SUPPORT DEVELOPMENT OF CRITICAL QMS DOCS WITH A
FOCUS ON:
O SOFTWARE (PLAN)
O SAFETY RISK MANAGEMENT (PLAN, HARMS, ANALYSIS)
O CYBERSECURITY (PLAN, ANALYSIS)
O USABILITY (NEEDS, PLAN, SPECIFICATIONS, ANALYSIS)
O PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS
DOCUSIGN ENVELOPE ID: 63F7EA40-8B14-4D05-9E9D-F6FFC4D60BA5
O SYSTEM AND ALGORITHM DOCUMENTATION
 PROVIDE CONTINUED SUPPORT FOR PROPERLY DOCUMENTING SOFTWARE RELEASES AND
HARDWARE DESIGN CHANGES TO MAINTAIN FDA COMPLIANCE.
NOTE THAT NONE OF THE ACTIVITIES ABOVE WILL BE PERFORMED BY PRIORITY DESIGNS IN
ISOLATION. INSTEAD, THEIR TEAM OF EXPERTS WILL BE INTEGRATED DIRECTLY WITH OSU SRI'S TEAM OF
EXPERTS TO ENSURE THAT WE HAVE THE PROPER EXPERTISE AND BANDWIDTH AT EVERY STEP OF THIS
PHASE OF THIS PROJECT TO E􀆯ICIENTLY EXECUTE AND ACHIEVE THE OBJECTIVES OF THIS GRANT. ALL
MILESTONES WILL BE REACHED COLLABORATIVELY, SO PRIORITY DESIGNS IS NOT SOLELY RESPONSIBLE FOR
ANY SPECIFIC MILESTONES AS THEY ARE HIGHLY DEPENDENT ON PRODUCTION FROM OUR OSU SRI TEAM
TO MEET GRANT OBJECTIVES. OUR PROJECT MANAGEMENT AND LEADERSHIP TEAM WILL EVALUATE
PROGRESS IN 10% INCREMENTS AS OUTLINED IN PAYMENT SCHEDULE BELOW AND USE THESE
INCREMENTS AS MILESTONES TO HOLD PRIORITY DESIGNS AND OUR TEAM ACCOUNTABLE AND ENSURE
FUNDS ARE BEING E􀆯ICIENTLY USED TO MEET PROJECT REQUIREMENTS AND OBJECTIVES.
